Name: SubmarineSteam
Notes: An effect object that will damage the player if they get too close. Utilises unique audio effects 'SE_OJ_LV_MARINE_STEAM_OUT_S' and 'SE_OJ_LV_MARINE_STEAM_OUT' if they are located in SkullSharkGalaxy.

SW_A.Description: Begins emitting steam whilst activated. Appears to be unused.

ClippingGroup.Description: Objects in this group are always clipped together.
